requirements.text: Create executable roadmap work for first-class horizontal alignment checks across KB, code, and KB-code layers.
Create executable roadmap work for unattended post-compaction/new-session pickup governed by /wiki-config agency policy.
Create executable roadmap work for heartbeat/wake coordination and parallel worktree scheduler/merge orchestration.
Create executable roadmap work to rename codewiki_task to codewiki_roadmap without compatibility alias.

summary: Accepted roadmap direction for autonomous CodeWiki orchestration hardening.

diff_table.current_state: Horizontal alignment is checked indirectly through graph health, generated parity, typecheck, tests, file-structure audits, and validator review, but no first-class horizontal KB↔KB, code↔code, and KB↔code audit contract exists.
diff_table.current_project_state: Horizontal alignment is checked indirectly through graph health, generated parity, typecheck, tests, file-structure audits, and validator review, but no first-class horizontal KB↔KB, code↔code, and KB↔code audit contract exists.
diff_table.desired_state: Horizontal alignment becomes a first-class audit/gateway capability with deterministic evidence for KB↔KB, code↔code, and KB↔code consistency.
diff_table.agreed_change: Create roadmap work for horizontal alignment audit profiles and source/API/spec assertion evidence.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Validation can require horizontal alignment profiles and report actionable drift/contradiction evidence.
diff_table.rationale: A production-ready anti-drift pipeline needs same-layer consistency checks, not only vertical traceability.

diff_table.current_state: CodeWiki can produce source-backed resume packets and safe post-gateway compaction, but unattended continuation after compaction or hard new-session boundaries still depends on adapter/orchestrator behavior and user babysitting in some cases.
diff_table.current_project_state: CodeWiki can produce source-backed resume packets and safe post-gateway compaction, but unattended continuation after compaction or hard new-session boundaries still depends on adapter/orchestrator behavior and user babysitting in some cases.
diff_table.desired_state: CodeWiki agency can pick up work after compaction or new-session boundaries without user babysitting when /wiki-config policy allows it.
diff_table.agreed_change: Create roadmap work for an autonomous post-boundary pickup runner seeded by codewiki_resume_context and gated by agency policy.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Approved agency modes can continue bounded task/sprint/roadmap execution from source refs after safe context boundaries.
diff_table.rationale: True automation requires the agent to resume from durable source refs without manual prompts after safe boundaries.

diff_table.current_state: Sessions coordinate through CodeWiki artifact status and claims, but durable wait/wake semantics and merge orchestration for fully parallel workers need hardening.
diff_table.current_project_state: Sessions coordinate through CodeWiki artifact status and claims, but durable wait/wake semantics and merge orchestration for fully parallel workers need hardening.
diff_table.desired_state: Different sessions communicate only through CodeWiki claims/builds/validation/queue state, with heartbeat, release wakeups, worktree isolation, and merge/publisher orchestration.
diff_table.agreed_change: Create roadmap work for durable wait/wake heartbeat queue, parallel worktree scheduler, and merge validator/publisher queue.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Independent workers can run in parallel, wake when needed artifacts release, and hand diffs to a merge/publisher agent for validation and serialized commits.
diff_table.rationale: Maximum safe parallelism needs coordination through durable artifacts, not chat between agents.

diff_table.current_state: The internal roadmap mutation tool is still named codewiki_task even though it manages tasks, sprints, checkpoints, archive state, and roadmap truth.
diff_table.current_project_state: The internal roadmap mutation tool is still named codewiki_task even though it manages tasks, sprints, checkpoints, archive state, and roadmap truth.
diff_table.desired_state: The internal tool is renamed to codewiki_roadmap, with no backward-compatible codewiki_task alias required.
diff_table.agreed_change: Create roadmap work to rename codewiki_task to codewiki_roadmap across tool registration, schemas, docs, skills, tests, and examples, fixing breakage directly rather than maintaining compatibility.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Agents use codewiki_roadmap for all roadmap/sprint mutations; codewiki_task references are removed unless historical artifacts retain their past text.
diff_table.rationale: Tool naming should reflect canonical ownership: roadmap mutation, not only task mutation.
